_comment: Business rules for the Product pages and the IsIntercompany flag. Edit here, not in code. See docs/product_data_runbook.md.

intercompany_customers._comment: Group-company customers. A sales line is flagged IsIntercompany when its Odoo partner id OR its customer name (trimmed, case-insensitive) is listed. The Product pages drop flagged lines (product_pages_exclude_intercompany); every other page keeps them (flag only).
names: شركة مجال بنغازي لاستيراد مواد البناء

_product_pages_exclusions_comment: Not real sales (branch-to-branch transfers, samples) are dropped from EVERY Product page and calculation before anything is computed: lines whose Customer Group (stored SegmentKey) is listed (3 Backoffice, 4 Inter Company) and, when true, lines flagged IsIntercompany. Promotion / Price / Process pages are not affected.

product_pages._comment: Product pages only (BCG Matrix, Stock Velocity, PIM Contribution, Product Lifecycle). excluded_companies are left out of every product table and total. unit_uom_names (case-insensitive) are shown as one unit, unit_label, and their quantities added together; any other unit of measure keeps its own name.

discounts._comment: Odoo product.product ids whose sales lines are discounts. Those lines keep their Odoo product name exactly as Odoo stores it; they are only flagged is_discount = 1 (never renamed).

stock_locations._comment: Odoo internal locations are grouped by warehouse name. On-hand = finished_goods only. In-transit is shown separately and never counted as on-hand. Raw-materials warehouses are excluded. Any internal warehouse not listed under raw_materials or in_transit counts as finished goods.

days_of_inventory._comment: DOH = finished-goods on-hand / (invoiced quantity sold in the last lookback_days / lookback_days). Stock > 0 with no sales in the look-back = 'No movement' and counts as Overstocked.

stock._comment: Stock Velocity page. ISR = inventory on hand value (LYD at cost, finished goods) / net sales value (LYD) of the selected period: green <= isr_target_pct, yellow up to isr_red_pct, red at or above isr_red_pct. Stock Aging = units-weighted average age (days since Odoo stock.quant in_date) of a product's finished-goods stock on hand; each bucket holds ages up to max_days (null = no upper limit).
stock._movers_comment: Fast vs Slow Movers: each SKU's velocity (units sold per day in the period) against the MEDIAN velocity of the SKUs of its own category in the same company: Fast >= fast_mover_vs_category_median_pct, Slow <= slow_mover_vs_category_median_pct, Normal in between.

sales_frequency._comment: Stock Velocity Sales Frequency: average days between selling days = days in the period / distinct selling days; each bucket holds gaps up to max_gap_days (null = no upper limit).

bcg._comment: Unchanged from the existing BCGMatrixBuilder. YTD invoiced quantity vs company threshold; GP% = (Value - Qty x standard cost) / Value. Products without a standard cost are 'Unclassified (no cost)'. Categories / products / customers left out of every Product page are in the input file ProductExclusions.xlsx (no longer here; product_pages_excluded_category_ids is read only when that file is missing).
bcg._movement_comment: Product Movement is on VOLUME: QtyYTD vs QtyLYTD (same calendar dates). Discontinued = archived in Odoo; New = first sale within lifecycle.new_first_sale_within_days or no LYTD volume; Improved / Drop = volume growth above +band / below -band; Stable = within the band.
